label: TRUTHMAKER_SCOPE_CONFIGURATIONS_1: Maximalist is Sound plus coverage of every true fact in the…
definition: Maximalist is Sound plus coverage of every true fact in the supplied carrier F at every world. Restricted is Sound plus coverage only in an explicit scope; it does not exclude additional makers. TruthmakerFree is Sound with no coverage requirement, not universal denial of makers. ExistenceScope contains the per-individual labels A.exist b; it need not include arbitrary compound or existential facts.
note: Analyst all-world policies, not source-stated modal quantifiers. Finite carriers give fragment-relative maximalism; TruthSetMap instead covers all Bool-to-Prop truth sets and certifies negation/conjunction closure. Neither encodes every essential/aboutness demand of substantive metaphysical theories. Nonvacuity witnesses and strict noncoverage are separately checked. Merricks’s broad mere-existence phrase is not identified with the narrower ExistenceScope.
